name: Name
body: This model is a ’jack marshal and can command warjacks (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: In most scenarios, this model can be deployed after normal deployment, up to 3" beyond the established deployment zone (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: In most scenarios, this model does not have to be deployed at the start of the game. Instead, it can be placed at the end of any of your Control Phases after the first turn (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model treats shallow water as open terrain (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) while advancing (<link="2"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>). While completely in shallow water, this model gains concealment (<link="3"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) and does not block line of sight.

name: Name
body: This warjack is a channeler equipped with an arc node and can act as a conduit for spells cast by its warcaster (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model can make an Assault ranged attack (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model is a cavalry model (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model can participate in combined melee attacks with other models in its unit (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model can participate in combined ranged attacks with other models in its unit (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model is a construct and is not a living model.

name: Name
body: This model can make melee and ranged attacks in the same activation. When this model makes its initial melee attacks, it can also make its initial ranged attacks. This model cannot make ranged attacks after making a power attack (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model ignores cloud effects (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) when determining line of sight. This model ignores concealment  <link="2"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) and Stealth (<link="3"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) and never suffers Blind.

name: Name
body: This model can fly (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model gains +2 on power attack damage rolls and on power attack collateral damage rolls.

name: Name
body: When this model makes a ranged attack while engaged, it does not have to target the model engaging it with the attack (see "Engaged Attacker," <link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model can make Headbutt power attacks (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model roams the battlefield in spectral form (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model treats rough terrain as open terrain (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) while advancing. While charging, slam power attacking, or trample power attacking, this model does not stop its movement when it contacts an obstacle.

name: Name
body: This model can make Slam power attacks (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This living model does not generate a soul token (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) when it is destroyed.

name: Name
body: Ranged and arcane attacks targeting this model from a point of origin (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) greater than 5" away automatically miss. This model is not an intervening model (see "Line of Sight & Targeting" <link="2"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) when determining line of sight from a model more than 5" away.

name: Name
body: When this model is disabled (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>), roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, remove 1 damage point from this model; it is no longer disabled and becomes knocked down (<link="2"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>). While knocked down, this model loses Tough.

name: Name
body: This model can make Trample power attacks (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This model is an undead model and not a living model.

name: Name
body: This model does not have to forfeit its Combat Action when it advances or is placed out of one or more enemy models’ melee ranges during its Normal Movement (see "Disengaging, " <link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: When this model suffers a cold damage roll, remove one die from the damage roll (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: When this model suffers a corrosion damage (see "Damage Types" <link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) roll, remove one die from the damage roll. Additionally, this model is immune to the Corrosion continuous effect (see "Continuous Effects" <link="2"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link> and "Continuous Effect: Corrosion" <link="3"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: When this model suffers an electrical damage (see "Damage Types" <link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) roll, remove one die from the damage roll. Additionally, when lightning arcs as a result of a special rule, ignore models with Resistance: Electricity when determining which model the lightning arcs to. Lightning cannot arc from a model with Resistance: Electricity.

name: Name
body: When this model suffers a fire damage (see "Damage Types" <link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) roll, remove one die from the damage roll. Additionally, this model is immune to the Fire continuous effect (see "Continuous Effects" <link="2"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link> and "Continuous Effect: Fire" <link="3"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>)

name: Name
body: Attacks with this weapon ignore bonuses from spells, including animi, that add to a model’s ARM or DEF.

name: Name
body: This weapon has an integral buckler that gives the model a cumulative +1 ARM bonus; for example, a model with two of them gains a bonus of +2 ARM. A model does not gain this bonus while the weapon system with the buckler is crippled.

name: Name
body: Attacks with this weapon ignore the Buckler and Shield weapon qualities and Shield Wall ARM bonus.

name: Name
body: A model hit by this attack suffers the Corrosion continuous effect (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: A model hit by this attack suffers the Fire continuous effect (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: On a critical hit (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>), the model hit by this attack suffers the Corrosion continuous effect (<link="2"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: On a critical hit (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>) on a warjack, the warjack suffers Disruption. A warjack suffering Disruption loses its focus points and cannot channel spells or gain focus by any means, including by being allocated focus, for one round.

name: Name
body: On a critical hit (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>), the model hit by this attack suffers the Fire continuous effect (<link="2"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This weapon causes cold damage (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This weapon causes corrosion damage (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This weapon causes electrical damage (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This weapon causes fire damage (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This weapon causes magical damage (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: A warjack hit by this attack loses its focus points and cannot channel spells or gain focus by any means, including by being allocated focus, for one round.

name: Name
body: A model making an attack with this weapon targeting a model it is in melee with ignores the Target in Melee bonus when resolving this attack (see <link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: This weapon is a shield that gives the model a cumulative +2 ARM bonus; for example, a model with two of them gains a bonus of +4 ARM. A model does not gain this bonus while the weapon system with the shield is crippled.

name: Name
body: This weapon can be used to make throw power attacks (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).

name: Name
body: When resolving an attack with this weapon, add an additional die to damage rolls.

name: Name
body: When this model suffers a blast damage roll, remove one die from the damage roll (<link="1"><color=#00F><font="BellGothicStd-Black SDF">LINK</font></color></link>).
